notes.title: Graphics polish update!
notes.notes: Version 36 of Puddle Knights arrives as a free update, preserving the dignity of the game almost 5 years since its launch! UI graphics have been polished for increased sharpness and a better look especially on higher screen resolutions, and there have been small tweaks to the appearance of foliage and ground inside the levels. The game also runs on a newer version of the Unity Engine.

notes.title: Bugfix patch version 34
notes.notes: Bugfix release version 34 fixes a crash that could happen after dragging a long path to an invalid move and then performing undo or reset! Happy puddling!

notes.title: Puddle Knights is now available in French and Japanese!
notes.notes:
Let the whole kingdom rejoice, Puddle Knights is now available in French and Japanese!

This is in addition to the previously supported languages: English, Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese, Finnish and of course Latin!

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase
notes.notes: See one of our dev team play through early levels of Puddle Knights in a special gameplay broadcast. The real tough puzzles will come later in the game, so hopefully we won't spoil the solutions for you too much! If you want to see whether you can tackle the game by yourself from beginning to end, it's available for sale during the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase at its lowest price ever.

notes.title: Localization update!
notes.notes:
Puddle Knights now features localization to 5 other languages in addition to English:
-Spanish
-German
-Simplified Chinese
-Finnish
-Latin (including Roman numerals!)

Needless to say, playing in Latin is the only way to get the fully historically accurate experience.

notes.title: Lava World update!
notes.notes:
Capes will be set on fire in an all-new world of Puddle Knights levels. There's an entirely new gameplay mechanic, a fire tile that only metal knights can move through without an issue. The levels open up a new alternative path to the end of the game, and contain some tough optional challenges.

Puddle Knights now totals 127 puzzles.

notes.title: Sky High update!
notes.notes:
Puddle Knights continue on their quest for hygiene in an all-new episode focused on rooftop rescues. The sky high world added to the end of the game explores fresh gameplay ideas using small variations on the existing mechanics. The levels vary in difficulty, but a few of them should prove challenging to even the smartest puddle solvers.

Puddle Knights now totals 111 puzzles, and more are coming!
